extracted.intended_audience: general newspaper readers / public interested in international and national news
extracted.subtask_description: A multi-item newspaper article (wire service style) reporting on international and domestic political and humanitarian events, diplomatic disputes, and government actions. Contains brief summaries of several unrelated news stories (atomic secrecy, U.N. debates, South Africa/Southwest Africa, travel restrictions for convicted communists, Yugoslavia/Cominform reports, refugee relief shipments, etc.).
